pages.text: The $(bold)Extractor$() is a versatile powered machine for extracting useful items from raw hemp materials.$(br)$(br)$(bold)What it processes:$()$(br)• $(bold)Hemp Leaf$() → Bio Composite (efficient, no hammer needed)$(br)• $(bold)Hemp Seeds$() → DNA Strand (needed for strain engineering)$(br)• $(bold)Any Strain Weed$() → That Strain's Extract (for the Mutator)$(br)$(br)The Extractor is critical for two major chains: $(bold)Bio Composite production$() and $(bold)DNA Strand extraction$() for unlocking new strains.
DNA Strands come from extracting Hemp Seeds. Fill them in the Synthesizer with 3 reagents, then use in the Sequencer to get a specific strain extract.
